title: Distribution-aware Noisy-label Crack Segmentation
mechanism: A SAM-Adapter for cracks, guided by distribution-aware domain knowledge so that it resists omitted and mislabelled cracks in small training sets; tested on an unseen crack dataset.
adaptation: Bold bet for E1: fine-tune a SAM / SAM2 adapter on 1-channel EL replicated to 3 channels at 1024 px, with noise guidance from the house-model 5-seed ensemble. Judge on E1 half-cut cells.
min_experiment: Arm: SAM2 adapter + noise guidance, 3 seeds. Baseline: house 5-seed ensemble on E1. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2. Kill if E1 relF1@2 < 0.47.
evidence: R (abstract): beats SOTA on two pavement crack datasets and generalises to the unseen CFD dataset.
prior_overlap: SAM2 Hiera-T was only linear-probed frozen (no sign of gain). Adapter fine-tuning with noisy-label guidance was not tried.
